WITH selected AS (
    SELECT t.id
    FROM automation.notification_tasks AS t
    JOIN automation.incident_cases AS c
      ON c.organization_id = t.organization_id
     AND c.incident_id = t.incident_id
    WHERE t.status IN ('pending', 'failed')
      AND t.attempts < 8
      AND t.next_attempt_at <= NOW()
      AND (
          (
              t.notification_type = 'initial_alert'
              AND c.status <> 'resolved'
          )
          OR
          (
              t.notification_type = 'manager_escalation'
              AND c.status IN ('open', 'escalated')
              AND c.acknowledged_at IS NULL
              AND c.resolved_at IS NULL
          )
      )
    ORDER BY t.next_attempt_at, t.created_at, t.id
    FOR UPDATE OF t SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 10
)
UPDATE automation.notification_tasks AS task
SET
    status = 'processing',
    attempts = task.attempts + 1,
    lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
    lease_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 minutes',
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM selected
WHERE task.id = selected.id
RETURNING
    task.id AS task_id,
    task.organization_id,
    task.incident_id,
    task.channel,
    task.notification_type,
    task.attempts,
    task.lease_token,
    task.lease_expires_at;

SELECT
    t.id AS task_id,
    t.organization_id,
    t.incident_id,
    t.lease_token,
    t.attempts,
    t.notification_type,
    c.title,
    c.priority,
    c.status AS incident_status,
    c.acknowledgment_due_at,
    c.escalation_due_at
FROM automation.notification_tasks AS t
JOIN automation.incident_cases AS c
    ON c.organization_id = t.organization_id
   AND c.incident_id = t.incident_id
WHERE t.id = $1::uuid
  AND t.lease_token = $2::uuid
  AND t.channel = 'discord'
  AND t.status = 'processing'
  AND t.lease_expires_at > NOW();
  AND (
    (
        t.notification_type = 'initial_alert'
        AND c.status <> 'resolved'
    )
    OR (
        t.notification_type = 'manager_escalation'
        AND c.status IN ('open', 'escalated')
        AND c.acknowledged_at IS NULL
        AND c.resolved_at IS NULL
    )
)

WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.notification_tasks AS t
    SET
        status = 'delivered',
        delivered_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE t.id = $1::uuid
      AND t.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND t.status = 'processing'
      AND t.channel = 'discord'
      AND t.lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND $3::integer = 200
      AND NULLIF($4::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING t.id
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS finalized;

SELECT
    t.id AS task_id,
    t.organization_id,
    t.incident_id,
    t.lease_token,
    t.attempts,
    t.notification_type,
    c.title,

FROM automation.notification_tasks AS t
JOIN automation.incident_cases AS c
    ON c.organization_id = t.organization_id
   AND c.incident_id = t.incident_id
WHERE t.id = $1::uuid
  AND t.lease_token = $2::uuid
  AND t.channel = 'email'
  AND t.status = 'processing'
  AND t.lease_expires_at > NOW();
  AND (
    (
        t.notification_type = 'initial_alert'
        AND c.status <> 'resolved'
    )
    OR (
        t.notification_type = 'manager_escalation'
        AND c.status IN ('open', 'escalated')
        AND c.acknowledged_at IS NULL
        AND c.resolved_at IS NULL
    )
)

WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.notification_tasks AS t
    SET
        status = 'delivered',
        delivered_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE t.id = $1::uuid
      AND t.lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND t.status = 'processing'
      AND t.channel = 'email'
      AND t.lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING t.id
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS finalized;

UPDATE automation.notification_tasks AS t
SET
    status = 'dead',
    last_error = 'Unsupported notification channel',
    lease_token = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE t.id = $1::uuid
  AND t.lease_token = $2::uuid
  AND t.status = 'processing'
  AND t.lease_expires_at > NOW()
  AND t.channel NOT IN ('discord', 'email')
RETURNING
    t.id AS task_id,
    t.channel,
    t.status,
    t.last_error;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.notification_tasks AS t
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Worker lease expired; external delivery outcome is uncertain',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE t.status = 'processing'
      AND t.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.lease_expires_at <= NOW()
    RETURNING t.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS uncertain_tasks_quarantined
FROM quarantined;

WITH quarantined AS (

    WHERE t.id = $1::uuid

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;
